dedupeText: vintage soul jazz percussion album cover 1960s soul jazz drum kit high angle shot mid century typography dynamic composition the diagonal tilt of the text block aligns with the upward motion of the drummer s right arm and stick the circular forms of the drum heads and cymbals create a rhythmic pattern across the lower two thirds of the frame the drummer s direct eye contact and smile provide a warm focal point against the cool dark studio floor combine a high angle action shot of a musician with a diagonal geometric sans serif typographic overlay that mimics the physical lines of the instrument or performer s limbs

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-angle, slightly distorted wide-angle photograph of a smiling drummer seated at a blue-sparkle drum kit, featuring a diagonal typographic block that follows the angle of a raised drumstick.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal tilt of the text block aligns with the upward motion of the drummer's right arm and stick.
The circular forms of the drum heads and cymbals create a rhythmic pattern across the lower two-thirds of the frame.
The drummer's direct eye contact and smile provide a warm focal point against the cool, dark studio floor.
coreInvariants: High-angle perspective looking down at the kit
Blue-sparkle finish on the drum shells
Muted, earthy color palette with high-contrast white drum heads

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The drummer is positioned in the upper right quadrant, while the drum kit occupies the lower left and center, creating a balanced diagonal split.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white snare and tom heads act as high-value anchors in the center-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the drummer's face, follows the arm down to the drums, then sweeps up the diagonal text block back toward the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, textured studio floor provides a neutral backdrop that makes the metallic and white elements pop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep olive and charcoal floor tones provide the base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white drum heads and text provide sharp legibility and focus.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Electric blue sparkle on the drum shells and cyan-blue logo accents.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-saturation background with high-value highlights on the hardware and skin tones.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'stereo' text uses an ultra-wide, extended geometric style with a distinctive 'e' and 'o' connection.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A bold geometric sans for the main title paired with a smaller, all-caps sans-serif for track listings.

avoid: Horizontal alignment for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric 60s/70s aesthetic and tight kerning capability.
Classic geometric proportions suitable for the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-angle photo of a drummer in a lime-green polo shirt playing a blue-sparkle drum kit on a dark studio floor. The drummer is smiling at the camera. One drumstick is raised high. The lighting is soft but directional, highlighting the white drum heads.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of bold geometric sans-serif text in lowercase, tilted at a 30-degree angle. The first line is mustard yellow, the second is white, and the third is mustard yellow. Place a small block of all-caps metadata text in white to the right of the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the text tilted to match the drumstick angle?
Are the drum shells a textured blue sparkle?
Is the perspective a distinct high-angle 'bird's eye' view?

mustAchieve: Authentic 1960s film grain and color grading

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not obscure the drummer's face.
Ensure the blue sparkle texture on the drums looks like physical glitter/wrap.
Verify the high-angle distortion feels natural to a wide-angle lens.
Confirm the color palette remains within the muted retro spectrum.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-angle action shot of a musician with a diagonal, geometric sans-serif typographic overlay that mimics the physical lines of the instrument or performer's limbs.
